condition.narrative: Should contribute directly to results for children as outlined in the UNDAF, national results and/or UNICEF Strategic Plan and within the scope defined in the CPD, CPAP, OMP or other agreed upon programme documents

title.narrative: About 310,808 adolescents and youth (55 per cent girls) accessed learning and skilling pathways. Of these, 70,625 out-of-school adolescents (57 per cent girls) accessed second-chance learning through ALP/NFE, and 12,730 (57 per cent girls) improved their digital skills. More than 79,397 adolescents and youth participated in civic engagement initiatives.
